//: Story Phase 6, chapter 26: The Frog Tax Man. Night. BWAAAAAH: the S.E.S. finds its first proper programme (data/tv/programs/frog_tax_man.json) and Garrick is lost to it. He falls asleep in the suit, hat sideways, onion in hand; the set stays on at full volume. Barnacle Bob wakes the captain ('I enjoy being alive'); Garrick wants five more minutes; the captain turns it off himself on the back panel's knobs (LOUD, MORE LOUD, PICTURE MAYBE, DO NOT TOUCH, FROG, ???, OFF MAYBE).

p6c2.begin.narrate: The supper went down. Nothing came back up. Not yet.

p6c2.deck: A noise like a cow falling down a staircase comes out of the Stenchmaster Entertainment System.
Then a jingle. A cheerful, tinny little jingle, the kind that's been written by somebody who has never been happy in their life.

p6c2.deck.text: It's ON! Captain! A PROPER programme!

p6c2.deck: The glass has gone a deep, bright green. Every face on deck is lit by it.

p6c2.deck.tutorial: Watch the S.E.S. with the Grand Stenchmaster (his station, midships).
p6c2.deck.title: The Frog Tax Man

p6c2.watch: You stand behind the chair. Garrick doesn't look round. He pats the barrel beside him: sit.
You don't sit. You do stay.
garrick[delighted]: It's a FROG, Captain. With a TIE.
garrick[laugh]: HAHAHA! The lily pad! NINE TIMES!
captain: What's depreciation?
garrick[businesslike]: Nobody knows, Captain. That's what makes it so tense.
garrick[laugh]: Work hours! WORK HOURS!
captain[tired]: ...That's quite good.
garrick[delighted]: IT'S VERY GOOD.
The laugh track is doing a great deal more laughing than the jokes strictly support. Garrick is doing more than the laugh track.
garrick[alarmed]: He took the STANDARD deduction!
captain: Is that bad?
garrick[terrified]: It's the BRAVEST THING I'VE EVER SEEN.
garrick[proud]: Quarterly estimates. Next week. I'll be here.
captain: Ye're always here.
garrick[smug]: And next week I'll be here with a REASON.
The programme ends. There is a crackle. Then the programme begins again, from the top. The S.E.S., it turns out, has exactly one episode, and it intends to play it until something stops it.
Halfway through the lily pad, the Grand Stenchmaster's chin drops onto his chest.

His hat slides sideways. The saucepan-lid medal rises and falls on his chest like a little tin tide. The cape slithers off the back of the chair onto the deck. In one hand, gripped tight, is half an onion.
captain: ...Garrick.
garrick[smug]: ...mmnf. Standard deduction...
You leave him to it. The laugh track follows you all the way to your cabin.
p6c2.woken: You've fallen asleep on the floor beside Squawks's basket. Neither of you meant to.
bob[sad]: Sorry, Squawks. Sorry. Sorry. It's the television, Captain.
bob[alarmed]: I enjoy being alive, Captain.
From up on deck: a sharp, dry CRACK, like somebody snapping a whip made of lightning.
captain: Then wake Garrick. It's HIS.
bob: I tried. He asked for five more minutes.
bob: Forty minutes ago. I've asked him four times since. He's very good at it, Captain. He doesn't even open his eyes. He just holds up five fingers.
squawks[furious]: Coming. Want to see it DIE.

p6c2.woken.tutorial: Go up on deck and do something about the S.E.S.
p6c2.woken.title: The Frog Tax Man

p6c2.deck_night: You set Squawks down by the cabin door. Far enough. You hope.
The S.E.S. is on full volume. The laugh track rolls across the deck like surf. Out in the dark, a fin turns toward it, interested.
A spark jumps off the frying-pan aerial, cracks against the grog table, and fizzles out.
The Grand Stenchmaster sleeps on, in his chair, in his suit, three feet from it.

p6c2.deck_night.tutorial: Try to wake the Grand Stenchmaster (his chair).
p6c2.deck_night.title: The Frog Tax Man

p6c2.wake: One gloved hand rises from the arm of the chair. Five fingers.
garrick[smug]: ...mm. It does that. Five minutes.
You shake him by the epaulette. The tassel squelches.
He turns over in the chair, which is not a thing a chair allows, and is asleep again before he's finished doing it.
bob[concerned]: That's what he did to me, Captain.
captain[tired]: Fine. I'll do it myself.
bob[alarmed]: Captain, there's a card taped on it says WAIT BEFORE POKING—
captain: I'm not poking it. I'm turning a KNOB.

p6c2.wake.tutorial: Turn off the S.E.S.: the knobs, on the outside of the set. (There are seven. One of them is OFF MAYBE.)
p6c2.wake.title: The Frog Tax Man

p6c2.knobs: Round the side of the set, at knee height, is a panel of knobs. Each one has a label, in Garrick's crayon.

else: You step back. Franklin carries on with his taxes. The laugh track carries on laughing at him.

else.tutorial: The S.E.S. is still on. Try the knobs again (OFF MAYBE, on the set's side panel).
else.title: The Frog Tax Man
